BehavioralAligner API

The BehavioralAligner class aligns extracted test behaviors with specification requirements using AI analysis.

class asabaal_utils.agents.spec_coder.align_behaviors.BehavioralAligner[source]

Bases: object

Aligns test behaviors with OpenSpec requirements.

Core Methods

align_all_tests

BehavioralAligner.align_all_tests(test_behaviors, spec)[source]

Align all tests to all requirements.

Return type:

List[AlignmentMatch]

Aligns all test behaviors with specification requirements.

Parameters: - test_behaviors (list): TestBehavior objects from analysis - spec (OpenSpec): Parsed specification object

Returns: - list: List of AlignmentMatch objects

Examples

from asabaal_utils.agents.spec_coder.align_behaviors import BehavioralAligner

aligner = BehavioralAligner()
matches = aligner.align_all_tests(test_behaviors, spec)

for match in matches:
    print(f"Test: {match.test.test_name} -> Requirement: {match.requirement.id if match.requirement else 'Additional'}")
